used in a trial.

text: In the study by Saavedra and Silverman (button phobia), the boy completed a disgust/fear
hierarchy by giving a distress rating to different stimuli on a scale from 0–8.
Describe the procedure during the brain scanning phase of the study by Canli et al. (brain scans
and emotions).

text: From the study by Baron-Cohen et al. (eyes test):
A teacher, Jayne, has a new class of students. Her students are not concentrating during films
(movies) in class. She is thinking of ways to help them and asks you for advice.
Outline the advice you would give to Jayne, using your knowledge of the study by Andrade
(doodling).
From the study by Dement and Kleitman (sleep and dreams):
Describe one result about dream recall in REM sleep and one result about the estimations of
dream-duration time in REM sleep. You must use data for one of these results.
